meaning: the entity is one Map Creator storage position: the cell a robot stands on to reach it, the heading it stands at, the direction the position lies in, its depth index and its height above the floor — a position with no rack anywhere in the export to derive it from

schema.$comment: Open to fields a newer producer adds (SPEC §9). Derived from `records.rs`'s field map by `vocabulary()`; edit the map, not this.

entity_id.description: One entity of this document, by identity. A declared identity is a UUID; a derived one is its root UUID and the generator's key path, which nothing in a converted document produces.
entity_id.title: entity_id

legacy_value.description: A legacy value the dump wrote, kept verbatim in whatever JSON kind it wrote it. It states no type on purpose: the round trip writes back what the dump said, and correcting a kind here would be the converter deciding what the site meant.
legacy_value.title: legacy_value

schema.description: the entity is one Map Creator storage position: the cell a robot stands on to reach it, the heading it stands at, the direction the position lies in, its depth index and its height above the floor — a position with no rack anywhere in the export to derive it from

height.description: Map Creator's `height`, carried as the export states it.

io_point.description: Map Creator's `io_point` object, field by field.

bot_orientation.description: Map Creator's `bot_orientation`, carried as the export states it.

cell.description: The cell Map Creator's `coordinate` names, by entity identity. The export writes the legacy spelling back from the identity, so no display string is load-bearing here (SPEC §2).

cell_unresolved.description: Map Creator's `coordinate` verbatim, present only when the cell it names is not in this dump. Never corrected and never dropped: the round trip writes back what the dump said, and the ledger counts it as a dangling source reference.

ndeep.description: Map Creator's `ndeep`, carried as the export states it.

relay_cell.description: The cell Map Creator's `relay_point` names, by entity identity. The export writes the legacy spelling back from the identity, so no display string is load-bearing here (SPEC §2).

relay_cell_unresolved.description: Map Creator's `relay_point` verbatim, present only when the cell it names is not in this dump. Never corrected and never dropped: the round trip writes back what the dump said, and the ledger counts it as a dangling source reference.

storage_direction.description: Map Creator's `storage_direction`, carried as the export states it.

storage_sector.description: Map Creator's `storage_sector`, carried as the export states it.
